name: 49068 · Marshall, MI
findings: ZIP 49068 (Marshall) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49068 (Marshall) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
